# Codex Research · full reference

> Codex Research (codexresearchlab.com) supplies laboratory-grade research peptides,
> batch-verified with a third-party certificate of analysis (COA) and 99% HPLC purity.
> Same-day delivery in Panama City (1-2 hours) and shipping across Panama and
> the United States. Orders are placed and paid on the site, by card (Stripe) or
> crypto (USDC/USDT); WhatsApp is support, not a required step to buy.

Last updated: 2026-10-02. Machine-readable pricing: https://codexresearchlab.com/pricing.md

All products are sold strictly for laboratory research and development. They are not for
human or animal consumption and are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any
disease. Dosage and clinical questions are outside what this catalog documents.

# Shipping and payment

Panama City: same-day delivery in 1-2 hours, $4 flat. Interior cities (David, Chitre, Colon and more): next business day via Fergunson transport. United States: $20 from U.S. stock, 48-72 hours. Free shipping over $100 (Panama) or $250 (U.S.). Always in sealed, protective packaging, with each vial labeled with its compound, strength and batch number.

Card (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) processed by Stripe, or crypto (USDC or USDT on Ethereum). Payment is completed on our own checkout, in both Panama and the United States. Card details go straight to Stripe and never touch our site.

**What is Bacteriostatic Water?** Bacteriostatic water is sterile, nonpyrogenic water with 0.9% benzyl alcohol added as a preservative, to USP specification. It is supplied as a general laboratory diluent; the label states its composition, pH and storage conditions. This 10 ml presentation is a larger multi-dose bottle. It is supplied as a lyophilized 10 ml vial for laboratory research use only.

**How much does Bacteriostatic Water cost?** Single vial: $17.00 USD. Pack · 3 vials: $46.92 USD. Prices are in USD.

**Is Bacteriostatic Water tested, and do you provide a certificate of analysis?** Yes. Every batch is tested at 99% purity by HPLC and mass spectrometry. The certificate of analysis is available on request, before you order if you want to see it first, and any vial's batch number can be checked at https://codexresearchlab.com/verify/.

# General questions

### Are your products verified?

Yes. Every batch comes with a certificate of analysis (COA) from an independent lab, with HPLC and mass spectrometry testing. Your vial’s batch number can be checked at codexresearchlab.com/verify/, and the full COA is available on request, before you order if you want to see it first.

### Where do you ship from and how long does it take?

Orders ship from local stock in each country. Panamá: $4 shipping, delivered in 1-2 hours in Panama City (interior cities like David, Chitré and Colón: next business day via Fergunson transport). United States: $20 shipping from our U.S. stock, delivered in 48-72 hours. Free shipping over $100 (Panamá) or $250 (U.S.). Always in sealed, protective packaging.

### Are these products for human consumption?

No. All products are sold strictly for research and development purposes and are not intended for human or animal consumption.

### Who can buy from Codex Research?

Only researchers buying for a research institution or laboratory: universities, hospitals and clinical research centers, private labs, biotech and pharmaceutical companies, and CROs. To order you open an account that names your institution, your role and your research area. Every account is reviewed by hand before it can place an order, and we may ask for an institutional email or proof of affiliation. We do not sell for personal use.

### Do you ship internationally?

Message us on WhatsApp with your destination country and we’ll confirm coverage, timing and cost before you pay.

### What payment methods do you accept?

Card (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) processed by Stripe, or crypto (USDC or USDT on Ethereum). You pay on our own checkout, in both Panamá and the United States. Card details go straight to Stripe and never touch our site.

### How should I store the products?

Lyophilized vials are stored cool and protected from light, and kept refrigerated (2-8 °C) once in solution. Every vial label shows its storage conditions.
